verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal is an API product, so an interactive API reference is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence documents an interactive or runnable API explorer. The published OpenAPI spec repository (docs-41) is a developer building block rather than an interactive reference, and the probe found no OpenAPI file served at the docs domain's candidate paths (probe-3). The CLI, MCP server and llms.txt are adjacent features and earn no credit here.
